title: A question for people with a lot of experience who have achieved good results.
author: Organic-Secret-
selftext:
I haven’t been in trading for that long. I traded crypto for about four years and had pretty decent results — nothing extraordinary, but I was satisfied with them.  
Eventually, I switched to trading forex, which is obviously a completely new market for me — although I understand that may not be the case for everyone.  
I’ve only been trading forex for about six months. During the first four months, I learned the hard way that the trading style I had developed from my experience in crypto simply didn’t work for forex — especially in my case, trading with prop firms, and eventually with my own capital as well.  
I realized what my mistakes were and started looking for a new strategy that would suit me better. Eventually, I found what I believe fits me best and backtested it over a three-year period, with more than 1,500 trades in total across different market conditions and instruments, including currency pairs, gold, and indices.  
I’ve now started trading it live.  
My question is this: based on the backtest and now after about two months of live trading, the results of this strategy seem quite impressive to me.  
I’m trying to understand whether there are actually traders who, like me, managed to find a strategy that genuinely suits them and continues to produce very strong results over the long term. Or is it possible that I’m still missing something or making a mistake somewhere?  
My statistics are: swing trade   
**Win rate: 54%**  
**Risk/reward: 1:2**  
**Risk per trade: 0.33%**  
**Maximum drawdown: around -3% in a single month**

comments.author: fomoz
comments.body:
I don't see any results here. What's your PnL? How many trades? 

I trade the most interesting markets. I think this is the most important thing for my AI bot fleet, other than settings and model choice. You can't squeeze blood from a stone, so to speak. 

I would be curious to try my bots on FX, but Hyperliquid doesn't have it and probably for good reason. It's too stable.

I used to trade FX and made good $ (tuned $30k into $135k in 2019-2020) but after I wasn't that good with it, too much stress and too many things happening at night because of London open (I live in EST).

Bottom line, right now I think AI and RAM stocks are the hottest market. But that depends if your bot can handle the volatility and make the most of it.
